instructions: Label the map below. Write the correct letter, A-G, next to Questions 1-4.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You will hear a tour guide speaking to a group of visitors about an amusement park.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: First, you have some time to read through questions 1-4.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 1-4.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: I'm glad you could all join us today at Fun Fortress Theme Park. As you may have already heard, this facility recently reopened after undergoing big improvements.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: So, first, I'll begin by explaining what visitors can do here. We are at the main gate at the moment, and there is a route you can follow from here to ensure you see most things in the park.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: After you enter the main gate, you will immediately see the public market on the right side of the road, where we sell a variety of souvenirs, snacks, and beverages.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Directly across the street from that is our spacious main stage. On the main stage, you can watch re-enactments of battles with knights, performances by medieval musicians, or comedy shows.
transcript.highlight_text: Directly across the street from that is our spacious main stage.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: And if you follow the side path to the west, you will see bouncy castle at the end on your right.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Now, if you're headed north from the main gate on the main route and take the second left, you'll come to our large rides area.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: This is where our most popular ride, the Dungeon Discovery Ride, and our newest ride, Castle Tower, can be found.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: The Dungeon Discovery Ride is the first one you see on the left as you enter the rides area.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: But Castle Tower is located in the far northwest corner, so you'll have to walk a bit more in that direction to find it.
transcript.highlight_text: Castle Tower is located in the far northwest corner

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: We also have a miniature village in the park. Get there, starting from the main entrance. Take the same route north toward the rides area.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Go past the turning to the forest pathway, and you will reach another path that turns to the right.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Take that path, and it will bend to the left and come to the entrance of the miniature village, located between the pathway and Queen's Pond.
transcript.highlight_text: entrance of the miniature village, located between the pathway and Queen's Pond.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: This includes a complete town and a range of famous landmarks and structures, all miniaturized of course.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Now, if you're interested in watching a show or a movie, you can go to the park's fun fortress 3D theater.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: To get there, you head north on the main route. Take the first right and head up the forest pathway. You'll eventually come to a small bridge that crosses the stream, and on the other side is the theater.
transcript.highlight_text: bridge that crosses the stream, and on the other side is the theater.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: We have a wide selection of new releases and kids classics, most of which are in 3D.

transcript.speaker: Tour Guide
transcript.text: Alright, those who would like to follow the route can come with me, and we will start at...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: You now have 15 seconds to check your answers.

items.explanation: The guide says the Public Market is on the right of the road, and the 'main stage' is 'directly across the street from that', which points to box G.
The guide mentions that Castle Tower is 'located in the far northwest corner' of the rides area, which matches box A.
The guide says the village is 'located between the pathway and Queen's Pond', which is exactly where box B is placed.
The guide instructions state: 'crosses the stream, and on the other side is the theater', which refers to box E located across the bridge.
